sovereign_country.strategic_role: 西欧核心消费市场、高客单价品牌合规与本土清关

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Fabless Integrated Circuit Architecture and IP Core Licensing

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Napoleonic Code; unitary national company-law regime under the French Commercial Code)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union, Article 49 et seq. (freedom of establishment)
France-Germany Double Taxation Agreement (1959, as amended by the 2015 protocol)
France-China Double Taxation Agreement (1984, as amended by the 2013 protocol)
France-United States Double Taxation Agreement (1994, as amended by the 2009 protocol)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: French Monetary and Financial Code, Articles L. 561-1 et seq. and R. 561-1 et seq. (AML/CFT obligations); French Commercial Code, Articles L. 123-32 et seq. and R. 123-166 et seq. (RCS registration); Order No. 2016-1635 of 1 December 2016 transposing Directive (EU) 2015/849 (AMLD4) into French law; French UBO register maintained by the registrar of the RCS pursuant to commercial and monetary code provisions.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation, constitutional documents, and current good-standing certificate of any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent corporate registry or commercial registrar in the shareholder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or, for non-Apostille countries, French consular legalization at the issuing state

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified French translation of all foreign corporate and constituent documents
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: French-registered court expert translator or certified translator recognized by the relevant prefecture
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized oath/signature on the translation certificate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Passport or national identity document of each beneficial owner and officer
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent authority of the beneficial owner's state of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized copy with Hague Apostille or consular legalization, plus certified translation where the document is not in French, English, or another accepted language

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of attorney executed by each foreign shareholder/UBO in favor of the French incorporation agent or counsel
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or equivalent authority in the shareholder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization with certified notarized signature

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter or proof of availability of registered capital
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Financial institution where the shareholder's capital contribution is held
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Original banker's letter with notarized signature (Apostille may be required by the receiving bank under French banking law)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, managers, and authorized signatories against the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, French asset-freezing decisions issued by the Ministry for the Economy (DG Trésor), U.N. Security Council consolidated lists, and OFAC SDN List for any USD-denominated clearing or SWIFT-Wire remittance. Persons politically exposed under FATF standards trigger enhanced due diligence pursuant to the enhanced due diligence provisions of the Code monétaire et financier; any positive match or unreconciled identity ambiguity must be reported to TRACFIN without delay before filing incorporation documents.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Guichet unique des formalités d'entreprises (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr), supported by the INPI register consultation portal (data.inpi.fr) and the RCS database maintained by the Greffes du tribunal de commerce
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The SARL denomination (raison sociale/dénomination sociale) must be available, lawful, not contrary to public order or good morals, and must not infringe pre-existing protected rights. The registered name may be in a foreign language, but the RCS will require the use of Latin-script characters; any non-Latin script must be accompanied by a single official Latin transliteration in the constitutional documents.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: République / National / État when implying French state endorsement
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The French RCS does not operate a general pre-approval name-reservation extension; if a name is rejected by the Greffe/INPI clearance process, the applicant should file, within 15 calendar days of the rejection notification, a formal application to the president of the competent tribunal de commerce (juge commis à la surveillance du registre), stating the requested name, the basis of availability, and the absence of confusion with protected signs. Where the refusal concerns an INPI trademark, an administrative opposition/re-registration path applies, and in all cases the applicant may file a new name application after eliminating the cited impediment.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for a fabless semiconductor design company provided the registered office is located in France through a licensed domiciliation contract (convention de domiciliation) with a real local address, personal mail-handling services, and a minimum three-year term. A bare P.O. Box or a non-substantive virtual address is not acceptable; the registered office must allow service of process, retention of books and records, and verification of commercial substance by the French tax administration.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk of unannounced on-site inspection is estimated at 10-15% for the first year of operation for a low-risk fabless semiconductor design entity holding no regulated financial licence; the likelihood rises if the tax administration conducts a full audit or if the domiciliation arrangement indicates no material presence at the declared address.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: INPI/RCS corporate name and trademark availability search
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: INPI and the Greffe du tribunal de commerce
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official per-search database fee and commercial registry consultation tariff

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Commercial, UBO, PEP, and sanctions due-diligence report
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Outside French counsel / AML compliance officer
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market flat fee for cross-border AML-required beneficial-ownership tracing

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified translation, notarization, apostille, and consular legalization of corporate and UBO documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Certified translator, notary, and competent French/foreign legalization office
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Per-document translation tariff, notarial tariff, and Hague Apostille/consular fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting and execution of the SARL articles of association (statuts) and related shareholders' resolutions
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market flat fee for a fabless SARL with non-resident corporate shareholders; notarial tariff where a notaire is required

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal announcement in an authorized legal gazette (annonce légale)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Journal d'annonces légales (JAL) recognized by the prefecture

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: RCS registration (immatriculation) and UBO declaration filing
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Greffe du tribunal de commerce / Guichet unique des formalités d'entreprises
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registry fee schedule (tarif des greffes) for SARL formation

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Three-year domiciliation contract for the registered office (first-year contribution)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market rate for licensed business-centre domiciliation, approximately EUR 90-100 per month

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Contingency reserve for administrative corrections and expedited filing charges
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prudent percentage contingency on official fee indices

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), principally Articles L223-1 to L223-43 and R223-1 to R223-36 governing SARLs; Articles L123-1 et seq. governing commercial registration; Articles L123-30 et seq. governing the Registre National des Entreprises.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises operated by the Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI); the competent local commercial registry is the greffe of the Tribunal de commerce, or the competent commercial court registry.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Electronic formalité de création filed through the INPI Guichet unique, supported by the signed SARL articles of association, beneficial-owner declaration, and applicable tax and social declarations.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital is required for a SARL; the capital may be set at EUR 1 or more. At least 20% of cash contributions must be paid upon incorporation, with the balance payable within five years of registration. Cash contributions are deposited into a blocked account or with a notary until registration. Contributions in kind must be described and valued in the articles; an auditor for contributions is generally required unless statutory exemption thresholds are satisfied.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Company accepts the subscription of all issued shares in accordance with the articles of association and acknowledges payment of the required initial cash contributions. RESOLVED, that the registered office is established at [full French address], effective upon registration. RESOLVED, that [name] is appointed Gérant for an unlimited term, subject to the articles and applicable law, and that [name] is authorised to complete all registration, banking, tax, employment, and licensing formalities. RESOLVED, that the Gérant may execute all documents necessary to implement these resolutions.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Reserve and verify the company name and business purpose
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI Guichet unique and INPI trademark database
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Verify name availability, domain conflicts, and trademark risks. Draft a sufficiently broad but accurate corporate purpose covering semiconductor architecture, integrated-circuit design, electronic-design automation, IP-core development and licensing, technical consulting, and related activities. Do not describe physical semiconductor fabrication unless the company will operate a fabrication facility.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Replace the proposed name or amend the corporate purpose if the registry identifies confusion, illegality, or insufficient specificity.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Prepare and execute the SARL articles
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Private execution before filing; notarial intervention only where legally required
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the articles in French or with a reliable French version. State the name, form, purpose, registered office, duration, capital, share allocation, management arrangements, and contribution terms. Obtain signatures from all founders. Notarisation is not generally required for ordinary cash contributions, but a notarial deed is required for contributions involving French real estate.
required_dossiers: Founder powers of attorney, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct inconsistent articles, obtain missing signatures, and re-execute defective pages before filing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Deposit capital and obtain the deposit certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: French bank, payment institution authorised to receive company capital, or notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary capital-deposit account using the draft articles and founder identification documents. Transfer the subscribed cash capital. Obtain the certificate confirming the amount deposited and retain the transfer evidence. The depositary releases the funds after presentation of the Kbis extract or equivalent registration evidence.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to bank compliance queries, provide source-of-funds evidence, and use another eligible depositary if onboarding is refused.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Authorised journal for legal notices in the department of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the statutory creation notice containing the company name, form, capital, registered office, purpose, duration, gérant identity, and applicable registration details. Pay the regulated publication charge and obtain the attestation of publication. Confirm that the notice matches the articles exactly.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Publish a correction notice where permitted and upload the corrected attestation if the registry rejects a materially inconsistent notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File the creation formalité through the INPI portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Create the electronic filing, select SARL formation, complete legal, tax, social, activity, establishment, and beneficial-owner fields, upload the documents, sign electronically, and pay the applicable registry charges. Identify the principal activity as semiconductor design and IP licensing rather than manufacturing where no fabrication occurs.
required_dossiers: Gérant identity document and declaration of non-conviction
Founder corporate documents and powers of attorney, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Monitor the INPI dashboard, answer registry queries within the stated deadline, replace unreadable documents, and resubmit corrected information through the same formalité.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain registration evidence and activate governance records
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe of the competent Tribunal de commerce and INPI Register of Enterprises
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Obtain the SIREN, SIRET, APE code, RNE registration evidence, and Kbis extract where issued. Release blocked capital, open the operating bank account, maintain the share-transfer register and beneficial-owner records, and retain signed resolutions and accounting books at the registered office.
required_dossiers: Kbis extract or equivalent registration evidence
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Request correction through the INPI or competent greffe, and challenge a formal refusal using the registry's stated appeal or rectification procedure.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Direction générale des Entreprises (DGE) of the French Ministry of the Economy, Finance and Industrial and Digital Sovereignty; local premises and environmental matters are administered by the relevant prefecture and regional DREAL.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No general French manufacturing or industrial operating licence is required for a fabless semiconductor design and IP-licensing business conducted from office premises. If physical semiconductor fabrication, chemical storage, testing infrastructure, or other classified installations are added, the applicable title is an Installation Classée pour la Protection de l'Environnement (ICPE) declaration, registration, or authorisation, as determined by the relevant nomenclature.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry for Ecological Transition; local review is generally handled by the regional Direction régionale de l'environnement, de l'aménagement et du logement (DREAL) and the competent prefecture.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt or not applicable for ordinary office-based fabless design and licensing activities with no industrial plant, process emissions, significant wastewater, or classified storage. An environmental assessment and ICPE procedure may apply if a fabrication, laboratory, high-capacity equipment, chemical-storage, or waste-treatment installation is introduced.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No process discharge or industrial VOC threshold normally applies to ordinary design offices. The company must comply with applicable municipal wastewater rules, workplace and building requirements, waste segregation and transfer documentation, hazardous-waste rules where relevant, and chemical-product obligations including REACH and CLP. Any future ICPE installation must meet its prescribed prefectural limits for wastewater, air emissions, noise, storage, and hazardous waste.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Before occupation, confirm commercial-occupancy and fire-safety compliance with the landlord and, where applicable, the local authority. An office open to employees or the public may be subject to ERP fire and accessibility rules, including evacuation routes, alarms, emergency lighting, extinguishers, and periodic inspections. Obtain structural-load verification for server rooms or specialist equipment, perform electrical and workplace risk assessments, prepare the mandatory DUERP, and arrange occupational-health registration. No separate industrial clearance is required unless physical manufacturing or classified installations are introduced.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) via the official portal impots.gouv.fr
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities must first establish French tax residency and then register with DGFiP to obtain the SIREN, SIRET, and VAT identification number (TIN/VAT ID) through the formal registration process outlined in the French General Tax Code
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Limited statutory elections available, including specific holding company regimes under the French Tax Code; no broad check-the-box equivalent

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time electronic invoicing for all B2B transactions effective October 2024; compliance requires use of certified platforms with digital stamping, API integration for clearance, and immediate transmission to tax authorities

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Eligibility for 0% VAT rate on exports of goods outside the European Union and qualifying offshore services to non-EU recipients, requiring proof of export and customer location outside EU
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or equivalent transport document
Inward Remittance Certificate or proof of payment
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent claims subject to penalties of up to 80% of the VAT amount evaded, interest charges, and potential criminal sanctions; retrospective clawback of zero-rated amounts with additional interest and fines

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France, acting within the Eurosystem under the European Central Bank framework; applicable foreign-exchange, payment, anti-money-laundering, sanctions, and capital-movement rules are also administered or supervised by the European Union, the French Prudential Supervision and Resolution Authority (Autorité de contrôle prudentiel et de résolution), the French Financial Markets Authority (Autorité des marchés financiers), the French Customs Authority (Direction générale des douanes et droits indirects), and the French Treasury (Direction générale du Trésor).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France uses the euro and has no general exchange-control regime applicable to an ordinarily operating French SARL. Current-account payments, including imports, exports, services, royalties, interest, dividends, and other ordinary commercial transfers, are generally freely convertible and transferable through regulated payment institutions. Capital-account transactions, including equity subscriptions, shareholder loans, acquisitions, and intercompany financing, are also generally permitted but remain subject to corporate-law formalities, bank source-of-funds review, beneficial-owner identification, anti-money-laundering and counter-terrorist-financing controls, sanctions screening, transfer-pricing requirements, withholding-tax rules, thin-capitalisation and interest-limitation rules, and applicable foreign-investment or national-security controls. Profit remittances require distributable profits, approved annual accounts, shareholder approval where required, correct accounting treatment, tax compliance, and review of applicable dividend, interest, royalty, or service-fee withholding obligations. Banks may request contracts, invoices, board or shareholder resolutions, tax evidence, proof of economic substance, UBO information, and evidence that transfers are not prohibited by sanctions, export-control, or anti-bribery rules. Semiconductor architecture, integrated-circuit design, cryptographic functionality, advanced computing, dual-use technology, and transfers to restricted destinations or counterparties may trigger European Union or French export-control, sanctions, or customs scrutiny.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: France has no general statutory requirement for a French SARL to surrender export proceeds to the Banque de France, convert a prescribed percentage of export receipts into euros, or repatriate receipts within a fixed foreign-exchange deadline. Export proceeds may generally remain in euro or foreign-currency accounts, subject to accurate accounting, tax reporting, customs documentation, sanctions compliance, bank monitoring, and contractual requirements. Exporters must retain commercially and fiscally relevant supporting records and comply with applicable customs, VAT, statistical, payment-services, and anti-money-laundering reporting obligations. Any specific reporting obligation may arise from unusual cross-border payments, cash movements, regulated financial transactions, sanctions, or statistical surveys, rather than from a mandatory foreign-exchange surrender ratio.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Crédit Agricole S.A. and the relevant Crédit Agricole regional banking entity
Banque Populaire and Caisse d'Epargne banking network operated by BPCE group entities

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium for secondary payment operations and low-to-medium as the sole treasury bank. An appropriately licensed European Union electronic-money institution or payment institution may provide payment accounts, safeguarding, foreign-exchange conversion, SEPA services, and certain international payment services within the scope of its licence and passporting notifications. It is not equivalent to a French deposit-taking bank: safeguarded electronic-money funds are not ordinary bank deposits and may not receive French deposit-guarantee protection. An offshore institution outside the European Economic Area cannot lawfully provide regulated payment or electronic-money services to French customers merely through a digital interface unless it has an applicable French or European authorisation, branch, passport, or other valid legal basis. Offshore accounts may be used by the SARL, but banks may apply enhanced due diligence, payment delays, correspondent-bank restrictions, and sanctions screening. Fintechs may be unsuitable for capital escrow, complex shareholder funding, high-value semiconductor licensing receipts, documentary trade finance, or transactions involving controlled technology.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: French law does not impose a universal requirement that all directors physically attend a bank branch to open a corporate account. Remote onboarding may be permitted subject to the bank's risk policy, reliable electronic identification, qualified or acceptable signatures, verification of the SARL's registration, confirmation of the legal representative's authority, UBO identification, and documentary validation. A bank may nevertheless require an in-person meeting, notarised or apostilled documents, live video verification, original documents, a French-resident contact, or a local branch appointment, particularly where ownership is non-resident, the group structure is complex, the source of funds is foreign, the company is newly incorporated, or the business involves intellectual property, dual-use technology, crypto-assets, sanctioned jurisdictions, or high-risk counterparties. The managing director or authorised legal representative must be able to complete the bank's KYC process; all UBOs and relevant controllers must be disclosed even when they are not directors.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Incomplete or inconsistent SARL incorporation records, outdated Kbis extract, missing articles of association, unclear managing-director authority, or failure to identify the ultimate beneficial owners.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Recent Kbis extract; signed articles of association; certificate of registration; shareholder register; ownership chart through every intermediate entity to natural-person UBOs; UBO declaration; director appointment resolution; specimen signatures; powers of attorney; identity and address evidence for directors, authorised signatories, and UBOs; certified translations where requested.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident shareholders, layered holding companies, nominee arrangements, trusts, private foundations, or ownership jurisdictions perceived as opaque.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full group organisation chart; constitutional documents for every shareholder; registers of shareholders and directors; independent corporate registry extracts; UBO passports and residential evidence; beneficial-ownership declaration; explanation of commercial rationale; tax-residence certificates; evidence that no nominee or undisclosed controller exists; legal opinions or notarised certifications where requested.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unexplained initial capital, shareholder loans, venture funding, or inbound capital from unrelated third parties.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed subscription agreement or shareholder-loan agreement; board and shareholder approvals; investor identification; source-of-wealth and source-of-funds evidence; audited accounts or management accounts of the funding entity; bank statements; financing term sheet; investment-fund commitment evidence; tax records; payment purpose and remitter-to-shareholder reconciliation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Semiconductor, cryptography, artificial-intelligence, advanced-computing, dual-use, or controlled-technology exposure creating export-control or sanctions risk.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed product and technology memorandum; IP ownership schedule; end-use and end-user policy; customer and distributor list; destination-country matrix; export-control classification analysis; applicable licences or licence-exemption assessment; EU and French sanctions screening records; restricted-party screening procedure; compliance officer designation; technology-transfer controls; contractual export-control clauses.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large or irregular cross-border royalty, licence, engineering, research, cloud, or intercompany-service payments lacking commercial substance.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed agreements; statements of work; invoices; delivery and acceptance evidence; IP registration or ownership records; transfer-pricing policy; benchmarking study; withholding-tax analysis; VAT analysis; time records or technical deliverables; board approvals; reconciliation to accounting ledgers and tax returns.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Payments involving high-risk jurisdictions, sanctioned territories, sanctioned banks, politically exposed persons, or counterparties with adverse media.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Counterparty KYC file; UBO identification; sanctions-screening results; PEP assessment; adverse-media review; transaction purpose; end-user certificate; shipping and customs records; legal review of applicable EU and French sanctions; documented escalation and approval; evidence that no sanctioned person, bank, vessel, or jurisdiction is involved.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-value export receipts or payments inconsistent with the stated fabless design profile, including physical-goods flows not supported by manufacturing or logistics records.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Business plan; customer contracts; purchase orders; invoices; foundry, packaging, assembly, and testing agreements; bills of materials; logistics records; customs declarations; proof of delivery; revenue-recognition policy; expected transaction-volume schedule; bank-account purpose matrix.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Use of personal accounts, cash-intensive settlement, third-party payments, payment splitting, circular transfers, or unexplained rapid movement between jurisdictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Treasury policy; approved bank-account list; segregation-of-duties matrix; payment-approval workflow; beneficial-payee verification; transaction-monitoring reports; explanation and supporting contracts for any third-party payment; cash prohibition policy; reconciliations; management certification; remediation evidence.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax, VAT, customs, social-security, or corporate-filing arrears that create financial-crime or credit concerns.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Recent tax-compliance certificates where available; filed corporate-tax and VAT returns; customs-account status; payment receipts; debt-restructuring agreements; management accounts; auditor or accountant confirmation; documented remediation timetable.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Route equity through the designated French capital-formation or capital-deposit account where required before registration or capital increase, using a regulated bank or authorised depositary. After incorporation or completion of the capital increase, transfer funds to the SARL's operational account only against the bank's release procedure and corporate documentation. Route shareholder loans, capital contributions, and intercompany funding through the operational account with the correct contractual and accounting characterisation. Use SEPA Credit Transfer for euro payments where available and SWIFT cross-border payment messaging for non-SEPA currencies or jurisdictions; use current ISO 20022 payment formats where supported. State an accurate payment purpose, such as capital subscription, shareholder loan, intercompany funding, royalty, services, or trade settlement, and identify the legal entity, remitter, beneficiary, invoice or agreement reference, currency, and ultimate economic purpose. Pre-clear material transfers with the bank, provide subscription or loan agreements, board approvals, UBO and source-of-funds evidence, and reconcile the remitting account to the disclosed investor. Do not route capital through unrelated third-party accounts, personal accounts, anonymous payment services, or crypto-asset channels. Confirm sanctions, export-control, tax, transfer-pricing, and beneficial-ownership requirements before release.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Use SEPA Credit Transfer or SEPA Instant Credit Transfer for eligible euro suppliers and SWIFT international payment messaging for non-SEPA payments, with complete ordering-customer, beneficiary, intermediary-bank, invoice, and purpose data. MT103 remains a common operational description for a single-customer international credit transfer, but banks are transitioning to ISO 20022-based formats and may represent equivalent payments through pacs.008 messaging. For documentary trade, use an irrevocable documentary commercial letter of credit issued or confirmed by a regulated bank, preferably subject to Uniform Customs and Practice for Documentary Credits (UCP 600), with documents such as commercial invoice, packing list, transport document, insurance document where required, certificate of origin, inspection certificate, and end-user or export-control documentation. Use documentary collections under URC 522 where appropriate, while recognising that collections provide less payment security than a commercial LC. Match every payment to a validated contract, purchase order, invoice, delivery or acceptance evidence, customs record where applicable, and approved counterparty. Apply dual approval, segregation of duties, beneficiary-change callbacks, sanctions screening, fraud controls, and three-way matching. Trade in semiconductor IP, design files, cryptographic technology, software, or technical data may require an export-control assessment even where no physical goods cross the border.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable foreign-exchange forwards with an authorised credit institution or investment firm, used to hedge documented forecast or contracted exposures and supported by treasury limits, counterparty credit limits, hedge documentation, and appropriate accounting treatment.

Non-deliverable forwards where the relevant currency, counterparty, jurisdiction, and product are legally and contractually eligible; settlement must occur through regulated counterparties and must not be used to circumvent exchange controls, sanctions, or payment restrictions.

Foreign-currency swaps and cross-currency swaps for documented financing or liquidity exposures, subject to applicable derivatives documentation, counterparty credit support, reporting, margin, conduct, and risk-management requirements.

Foreign-exchange options, collars, and other permitted OTC or exchange-traded derivatives may be used only after assessing MiFID II classification, appropriateness or suitability requirements where applicable, EMIR reporting and risk-mitigation obligations, collateral terms, valuation controls, and the SARL's internal treasury mandate.

Hedges should be linked to identifiable forecast or committed exposures, approved under a written treasury policy, executed with regulated counterparties under appropriate master documentation such as an ISDA agreement where relevant, independently valued, reconciled, and monitored for leverage, liquidity, collateral, counterparty, basis, and termination risks.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual ordinary shareholders' meeting (AGO) approving the statutory financial statements, allocation of income, and management report, followed by deposit of the certified annual accounts at the RCS.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du tribunal de commerce / Registre du commerce et des sociétés (RCS)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Six months after fiscal year-end; for a 31 December closing, filing deadline is 30 June of the following year unless judicial extension is granted.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file accounts: fine up to EUR 1,500 for natural persons or EUR 7,500 for legal entities; failure to convene the AGO may be sanctioned by court-ordered dissolution on petition of any interested person; continued non-filing for more than three fiscal years allows the greffe to initiate administrative strike-off (radiation) from the RCS.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate income tax return (liasse fiscale n°2065 and annexes) and settlement of corporate income tax balance due.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a calendar-year fiscal year, e-filing by the annual DGFiP-issued deadline (in 2024, 2 May); for off-calendar closings, no later than three months after the fiscal year-end, with mandatory electronic filing conditions.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late return: 10% penalty assessed on the tax due, plus late-payment interest of 0.20% per month; if no return is filed, automatic lump-sum tax assessment and formal notice by DGFiP; administrative revocation from RCS is not triggered by tax arrears alone.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial owner declaration (déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs, DBE) — initial, change-driven, and triennial confirmation.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du tribunal de commerce (RCS filing section)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Initial filing on incorporation; update within 30 days of any share transfer that modifies beneficial ownership; if no change, fresh confirmation by the third anniversary of the last filed declaration.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Intentional failure to file or inaccuracy: up to six months' imprisonment and EUR 7,500 fine for natural persons; legal entities exposed to five times those amounts (EUR 37,500), publication of the conviction and possible ban on corporate management; continued omission may be included in the greffe's strike-off formalities.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: CVAE annual value-added contribution return (n°1330-CVAE) for companies with production value exceeding EUR 500,000.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by the DGFiP calendar; for a 31 December closing, the return and final payment are generally due by 5 May of the following year; advance instalments are payable in line with the initial and mid-year deadlines.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty of 5–10% plus monthly late-payment interest; CVAE was progressively reduced from 2024 and is scheduled to disappear for any production value generated after 31 December 2026, subject to the tax legislation in force.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual business property contribution (CFE) — filing and payment of the property-based element of the territorial economic contribution.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local tax office (Service des impôts des entreprises / Trésorerie)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual notice generally payable by 15 November of the tax year; changes to property items declared on Cerfa form n°1442-C by 3 May for movement occurring in the prior year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to pay by the due date: 5% late penalty, statutory late interest, and enforcement through attachment by the comptable public; omission from the assessment list can result in recovered tax for the entire elapsed period.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A mandatory independent statutory auditor (commissaire aux comptes) must be appointed, and an audit performed, where the SARL exceeds two of the following three thresholds for two consecutive financial years: (1) balance-sheet total above EUR 6,000,000, (2) net turnover exclusive of tax above EUR 12,000,000, and (3) average number of employees equal to or greater than 50; shareholders may still appoint an auditor voluntarily outside these thresholds.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Standalone statutory financial statements are prepared under French GAAP (Plan Comptable Général, regulated by the Autorité des Normes Comptables); IFRS as endorsed by the EU is permitted for consolidated accounts but not for the individual SARL filing package.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under the French Monetary and Financial Code, the beneficial-owner declaration is filed with the RCS at incorporation and is updated within 30 days of any event changing identity or share of control. If no change occurs, a renewed declaration is required every three years. Therefore the confirmation cycle is triennial absent a reportable share transfer; in every fiscal year the directors must compare the register against the latest known shareholder structure, record any transfer in the minutes, and file the modified DBE within the 30-day window. A governance memorandum of the ordinary meeting is used to evidence the annual review.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of associates/members (Registre des associés / shareholders' register)
Shareholders' meetings and resolutions minute book (Registre des délibérations et décisions des associés)
Corporate officers' and managers' register (Registre des mandataires sociaux, for internal evidence alongside RCS filings)
Register of share transfers (Registre des mouvements de titres, maintained for SARL to evidence ownership chain)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: EUR 120–650 per year (approximately USD 130–700) for commercial domiciliation in Paris; lower ranges outside major cities.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: EUR 4,000–15,000 (approximately USD 4,400–16,500) for a small fabless semiconductor SARL without a mandate, depending on complexity and use of simplified audit procedures.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: R&D tax credit (Crédit d'Impôt pour la Recherche up to 100% of eligible expenses), innovation status benefits, accelerated depreciation for qualifying assets

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulaire 1201 - Déclaration de résultat via impots.gouv.fr or B2B portal
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: 3 months after fiscal year-end (e.g., 31 March for 31 December fiscal year)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income before tax credits and adjustments
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-residents report only French source income; permanent establishment adjustments required
Non-residents may claim under specific conditions with supporting documentation

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: 0.75% per month of tax due (minimum €200, maximum 10% of tax), plus 40€ daily surcharge after 3 months, plus interest at base rate + 0.2%

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% for qualifying participations under EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive to EU entities; otherwise 12.8% or DTA rate
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Obtain Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from home country, submit beneficial ownership declaration and TRC to French tax authorities via impots.gouv.fr for refund or credit
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: 0% under most DTAs and intra-EU; Interest: 0% under most DTAs, France applies 12.8% but treaties often reduce to 0%

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: €50 million turnover for Local File; €750 million for Master File and Country-by-Country Report
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: France implements EU Economic Substance Directive; entities must demonstrate adequate substance for IP holding or risk recharacterization of transactions

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Understating taxable income or misstating transfer prices without economic justification
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal prosecution, fines up to 500% of evaded tax, imprisonment up to 5 years
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal criminal liability, disqualification from office, possible jail time

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining French SARL with no real economic activity or substance in France
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Dissolution of company, back payment of taxes, fines up to €75,000
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Piercing the corporate veil, personal restitution obligations, potential criminal sanctions

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to maintain adequate TP documentation or suspicious cross-border flows without substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fines up to €1 million or 5% of annual turnover, possible criminal referral
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal fines, imprisonment for willful misconduct, travel bans in severe cases
